classes.doc:
** This class is a preview feature and may change in future releases. Do not use it in distributed programs. **

Object that represents a study inside a simulation model.

functions.doc: Creates a copy of this study
functions.name: clone

functions.doc: Deletes this study from the simulation model
functions.name: deleteMe

functions.doc: Initiates a solve operation for this study
functions.name: solve

functions.doc: Initiates mesh generation for this study
functions.name: generateMesh

functions.doc:
Opens the results viewer for this study, transitioning the Simulation workspace
into the Results environment
functions.name: showResults

functions.doc:
Closes the results viewer for this study, returning the Simulation workspace to the
setup environment
functions.name: exitResults

classes.name: Study

properties.doc: The name of the study as displayed in the browser
properties.name: name

properties.doc: The LoadCases collection that provides access to existing load cases in the study
properties.name: loadCases

properties.doc: Gets the current pre-check state of the study indicating whether it is ready to solve
properties.name: precheckState

properties.doc: Gets the pre-check messages (errors and warnings) for this study
properties.name: precheckMessages

properties.doc: Gets whether this study is the active study in the simulation model
properties.name: isActive

properties.doc: The Contacts collection that provides access to existing contacts in the study
properties.name: contacts

properties.doc: Returns the material assignments for all bodies in the study
properties.name: materialAssignments

properties.doc: Gets the current state of this study's solve results
properties.name: resultState

properties.doc: Gets the current state of this study's mesh
properties.name: meshState

properties.doc: The PointMasses collection that provides access to the point masses in the study
properties.name: pointMasses

properties.doc: Returns the safety factor thresholds used for results visualization color bands
properties.name: safetyFactorThresholds

attributes.doc:
Metric (SI) unit system
Length: mm, Mass: kg, Time: s, Force: N, Pressure: MPa,
Temperature: K, Energy: J, Power: W, Acceleration: m/s^2, Flow Rate: CMH, Angle: deg,
Velocity: m/s, Viscosity: Ns/m^2.
attributes.name: MetricSIUnitSystem

attributes.doc:
U.S. (in) unit system
Length: in, Mass: lbmass, Time: s, Force: lbforce, Pressure: psi,
Temperature: F, Energy: Btu, Power: Btu/s, Acceleration: ft/s^2, Flow Rate: CFM, Angle: deg,
Velocity: ft/s, Viscosity: lbforce * s/ft^2.
attributes.name: ImperialUnitSystem

attributes.doc: Custom unit system that allows any combination of units per quantity.
attributes.name: CustomUnitSystem

classes.doc:
** This enum is a preview feature and may change in future releases. Do not use it in distributed programs. **

Predefined unit systems available for simulation studies.

Attributes:
    MetricSIUnitSystem: Metric (SI) unit system:
        Length: mm, Mass: kg, Time: s, Force: N, Pressure: MPa,
        Temperature: K, Energy: J, Power: W, Acceleration: m/s^2, Flow Rate: CMH, Angle: deg,
        Velocity: m/s, Viscosity: Ns/m^2.
    ImperialUnitSystem: U.S. (in) unit system:
        Length: in, Mass: lbmass, Time: s, Force: lbforce, Pressure: psi,
        Temperature: F, Energy: Btu, Power: Btu/s, Acceleration: ft/s^2, Flow Rate: CFM, Angle: deg,
        Velocity: ft/s, Viscosity: lbforce * s/ft^2.
    CustomUnitSystem: Custom unit system that allows any combination of units per quantity.

attributes.doc: The mesh state is unknown or the study does not support mesh generation.

classes.doc:
** This enum is a preview feature and may change in future releases. Do not use it in distributed programs. **

The state of the study's mesh.

Attributes:
    UnknownMeshState: The mesh state is unknown or the study does not support mesh generation.
    NoMeshState: No mesh is available. The study has not been meshed.
    UpToDateMeshState: A mesh is available and up to date with the current study definition.
    OutOfDateMeshState: A mesh is available but the study has been modified since the last mesh generation.
    FailedMeshState: The last mesh generation failed with errors.
    MeshingMeshState: Mesh generation is currently in progress.
classes.name: StudyMeshStates

attributes.doc: The result state is unknown or has not been computed yet.
attributes.name: UnknownResultState

attributes.doc: No results are available. The study has not been solved.
attributes.name: NoResultState

attributes.doc: Results are available and up to date with the current study definition.
attributes.name: UpToDateResultState

attributes.doc: Results are available but the study has been modified since the last solve.
attributes.name: OutOfDateResultState

attributes.doc: The last solve failed with errors.
attributes.name: FailedResultState

attributes.doc: A solve is currently in progress.
attributes.name: SolvingResultState

classes.doc:
** This enum is a preview feature and may change in future releases. Do not use it in distributed programs. **

The state of the study's solve results.

Attributes:
    UnknownResultState: The result state is unknown or has not been computed yet.
    NoResultState: No results are available. The study has not been solved.
    UpToDateResultState: Results are available and up to date with the current study definition.
    OutOfDateResultState: Results are available but the study has been modified since the last solve.
    FailedResultState: The last solve failed with errors.
    SolvingResultState: A solve is currently in progress.
classes.name: StudyResultStates
